dedupe_keys.name: xbat waste electrical equipment battery images

description: The XBAT+ team publishes annotated optical and X-ray images of battery-containing waste electrical and electronic equipment. The own Zenodo release separates raw and resized RGB and X-ray packages into training, test and image-quality groups. The article reports 3,045 images from 421 devices in fifteen selected categories collected around recycling facilities and events. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The labels can train sorting or battery-detection components before simulating recycling-facility throughput and safety. Coverage is sampled small devices, not the full composition of household or industrial waste streams. A caveat is that multiple pictures of one device must stay in the same evaluation split to avoid leakage. Different image quality and sensor settings can alter detection performance. Own metadata and the Data Records section were read without downloading archives or assessing annotation reliability. The image post-processing script is a separate Zenodo resource; no related catalogue record was identified.
